title: The canon guard does not know the retired audience framings, and Market Read is keyed to retired personas
detail:
PR 3 (ADR-1715). Adds the superseded framings (spiritual refugees, witchy wellness, burnt-out seekers, calm fire, quiet revolution, the retired persona trio) to BANNED in scripts/check-canon.mjs, plus a member-audience rule that fails when an archetype name or the word seekers reaches member copy. Re-keys lib/marketing/market-read.ts cards to archetypes (activation gap: Wired Professional and Transplant; the unmissed: the Seeker family; what is alive: Activity-First Man) and removes its em dashes, since the new rule would fail on it. check-canon.test.ts plants witchy wellness and Wired Professional and proves both fail.

CLOSED 2026-10-06. scripts/check-canon.mjs BANNED gains spiritual refugees, witchy wellness, burnt-out seekers, calm fire, quiet revolution and the two retired persona names (everyone audience), plus member-audience rules for an internal archetype name and the word seekers. lib/marketing/market-read.ts is re-keyed (activation gap: Wired Professional and Transplant; the unmissed: the Seeker family; what is alive: Activity-First) with its em dashes removed, and the two seekers strings in lib/onboarding/example-sequences.ts became people, since the new rule failed on them. check-canon.test.ts plants witchy wellness and Wired Professional and proves both fail.

verify.cmd: node -e 'const fs=require("fs");const r=(p)=>{try{return fs.readFileSync(p,"utf8")}catch{return ""}};const fail=(m)=>{console.error(m);process.exit(1)};const c=r("scripts/check-canon.mjs");if(!/witchy/i.test(c))fail("check:canon does not ban the retired witchy wellness framing");if(!/Wired Professional/.test(c))fail("check:canon has no rule stopping an archetype name from leaking into member copy");if(/High-Functioning Lonely|Post-Screen Skeptic|All three personas/.test(r("lib/marketing/market-read.ts")))fail("Market Read is still keyed to the retired personas")'
verify.note: Fails while check:canon lacks the retired framings or the archetype-leak rule, or Market Read still names a retired persona.
